verdict.rationale: GitLab ships AI features (Duo Agent Platform), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no statement about whether customer data is used for model training, and no opt-out control. The ability to turn the Agent Platform on or off is an adjacent feature toggle, not a training-data opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
